units.source_text: 自从去年以来，弘徽殿太后被妖魔缠身，时时患病。

en.t: Since last year, the Kokiden Empress Dowager had been haunted by evil spirits and was often ill.

units.source_text: 宫中又出现种种不祥之兆，人心惶惶。

en.t: Various ominous signs also appeared within the palace, and everyone was filled with anxiety.

units.source_text: 朱雀帝的眼疾，曾因虔诚斋戒祈祷而一度好转，但此时又严重起来。

en.t: Emperor Suzaku's eye illness had once improved through devout fasting and prayers, but now it became severe again.

units.source_text: 圣心恼乱，便于七月二十过后再度降下圣旨，催促源氏从速返京。

en.t: Troubled in his imperial heart, he issued another imperial order after the twentieth day of the seventh month, urging Genji to return to the capital at once.
